name: v3_jetfoil_front_sweep
description: ATLAS V3 small (draft masses): grid over the three jetfoil jet angles (thrust tilt from vertical, per station) and the nose jets' sideways tilt. Every candidate flies Stabilized at its own static trim pitch (v3_stab_nolift, attitude 'trim'). Score: hover attitude error plus heading drift and position drift (the V3 draft's weak points), liftoff/landing upsets, touchdown speed and saturation.
objective: phases.hover.pitch_err_rms_deg + phases.hover.roll_err_rms_deg + 0.05 * abs(phases.hover.yaw_drift_deg) + 0.5 * phases.hover.pos_drift + 0.2 * (phases.liftoff.pitch_max_deg + phases.liftoff.roll_max_deg) + 0.2 * (phases.landing.pitch_max_deg + phases.landing.roll_max_deg) + 2 * metrics.touchdown_speed + 5 * metrics.saturation_fraction
